text:
tara: Quick FYI: starting a scoped least-privilege sweep for analytics service accounts. owners will get a ping. aim: remove stale admin entitlements but avoid touching incident temp grants.

lee: noted. big ask: can we make the demotion job respect a `grant_label` like `incident:<id>` and `do_not_prune`? last sweep hit a temporary elevation and caused ticket noise.

mohit: +1. also saw some KMS grant records with NULL requestor in the last 30 days. those correlate with an audit-webhook deploy on 2026-03-18. might be missing payloads.

gabi: we should backfill from s3 raw webhooks before any automatic demotion. i'll run a dry-run match and post counts.

access-bot: Automation notice: entitlement sweep "svc-admin-prune" scheduled for 2026-04-10T02:00Z. Current config: grace_days=7. To change, open PR infra/tools/admin-prune.

tara: let's set grace_days=14 for this pass and require `grant_label` IS NULL AND created_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days' for pruning. avoids recent incident work.

lee: will open infra#3012 to add `grant_label` and `do_not_prune` boolean and persist incident_id when webhook sees an incident. also make webhook idempotent to prevent dup grants.

mohit: suggested query to generate a whitelist of incident-tagged grants: 
```
SELECT grant_id, principal, created_at, metadata->>'incident_id' AS incident_id
FROM kms_grants
WHERE metadata ? 'incident_id' = TRUE
  AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '90 days';
```

gabi: dry-run backfill results: matched 22 of 31 missing requestors from s3 payloads; 9 remain unmatched. posting list in infra#3013.

lee: for the 9 unmatched, propose we tag `do_not_prune=true` and `audit_gap=true` and exclude them from the sweep for 30 days. we'll revisit after forensic logs are resolved.

tara: fine by me. add a column to the review sheet for `audit_gap` so owners can see which rows need manual evidence. also add `grant_origin` (sdk | console | support-lambda).

mohit: small snippet to backfill grant_origin from audit_events: 
```
UPDATE kms_grants g
SET grant_origin = e.source
FROM audit_events e
WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id
  AND g.grant_origin IS NULL;
```

infra-bot: Action queued: create PR infra#3012 to add fields `grant_label`, `do_not_prune`, `audit_gap`. To change grace_days open infra/tools/admin-prune#update-grace.

gabi: i'll produce the whitelist for the demotion job by Wed EOD and mark the unmatched with `audit_gap`.

lee: i'll revoke duplicates from the support-lambda retry incident and leave one canonical grant per session. also adding better retry backoff to the webhook lambda.

mohit: after the sweep we should run a short post-report: total scanned, demoted, whitelisted, and unmatched audit gaps. i'll take that.

tara: plan recap: (1) infra#3012 adds fields + webhook idempotency, (2) grace_days=14 for this run, (3) gabi whitelist and backfill by Wed, (4) lee revoke dup grants and patch webhook, (5) mohit post-run report. pause sweep if new grant churn appears.

access-bot: Acknowledged. To pause `svc-admin-prune` comment `pause sweep` in the PR thread.

lee: one more ask: owners should be able to mark `temporary_elevation=yes` manually in the sheet to override automation if needed. tara, can you add that?

tara: yes will add `temporary_elevation` column and short owner instructions. sending owner comms today.

gabi: posting infra#3013 link with matched/unmatched lists now. will ping when whitelist is uploaded to the review sheet.

mohit: thanks everyone. quick emoji check: :thumbsup: if you agree on 14d and audit_gap exemptions.

lee: :thumbsup:

gabi: :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup:

access-bot: Summary logged: sweep scheduled 2026-04-10T02:00Z, grace_days=14 (pending PR), exemptions: incident-tagged + audit_gap flagged grants.
